title: Navio
tagline: Incentivized collection of large roadside video datasets, to improve AI training for autonomous vehicles
description:
We will enable incentivized, continuous collection of road data at scale -- from the growing numbers of car drivers with dash cameras and from biking enthusiasts using GoPro and similar video recorders. 
We envision a token-based economy where revenues come from subscription fees that carmakers around the world pay to access our constantly growing and optimized video data sets.   Our platform will use blockchain  to verify and reward data providers, and keep immutable records of data sources while preserving the privacy of drivers.
how_its_made:
Project needs more work.  We will renew efforts after the hackathon. 
Among tech stack, we will use Filecoin and Lillypad.
